subject: Pilot ops contacts + success slate for RetailAI trial
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@retailai.com>, Peter Lowe <peter.lowe@retailai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot ops contacts + success slate for RetailAI trial

Hi Samira / Peter — thanks again for today's discovery. Quick recap and the concrete next steps so we have a single source of truth before kickoff.

TL;DR: RetailAI wants a 2-week in-environment trial focused on: 1) inference latency on product catalog queries, 2) correctness on inventory-aware responses, and 3) privacy controls (no user PII stored). To be successful we need an infra owner, an app owner, an app-security liaison, and procurement sign-off.

What I'm attaching here: a one-page success criteria workbook and a starter contact roster for the pilot ops team (both editable). Please review and confirm owners by Wednesday.

Key success criteria (draft)
- Latency: 95th percentile for common queries < 220ms
- Quality: pass rate on our eval set >= 88% (precision w/ retailer-specific prompts)
- Data handling: no customer PII persisted; audit log available for sampling
- Stability: no more than 2 retries per 1k requests during peak test window

Immediate asks from RetailAI:
1) Who will own the infra side (network/VPC, egress rules, keys)?
2) Who will own app integration (embedding calls, prompt routing)?
3) Is procurement ready to accept standard trial T&Cs or do you need a redline?

Next steps from Redwood:
- We will provision a sandbox project and share an endpoint + sample prompt set by EOD Monday. (Attachment: redwood-poc-success-criteria.xlsx)
- Karthik will follow up on procurement and share the intake for billing / SOW if needed.
- Ben will book a short technical kickoff with the infra/app/security owners once confirmed.

Attachments: redwood-poc-success-criteria.xlsx, pilot-ops-contact-roster.csv

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0148
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@retailai.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Peter Lowe <peter.lowe@retailai.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 11:48:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot ops contacts + success slate for RetailAI trial

Thanks, Soojin — useful summary. Quick answers inline: 

- Infra owner: I'll put Peter as infra owner but he'll delegate day-to-day to our cloud ops lead (Marcos Velasquez, cc'ed in my internal thread). For the trial we need VPC peering and a short egress rules checklist.
- App owner: that's me — I'll own integration with our product search service and provide a tech contact.
- Security liaison: we'll assign an app-security lead; final name by Tuesday.
- Procurement: we can sign a standard trial agreement but we need a short statement of data usage and an explicit audit window.

I'll take a look at the success criteria workbook and the roster tonight and confirm owners. Also, can Redwood supply a minimal example of the audit log format so our compliance folks can pre-clear it?

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Product, RetailAI
samira.khan@retailai.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@retailai.com>, Peter Lowe <peter.lowe@retailai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 08:03:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot ops contacts + success slate for RetailAI trial

Appreciate the quick replies, Samira. Short answers:
- Audit log sample: attached a one-page schema (also uploaded to the Drive link). It shows timestamp, request id, truncated input hash, and retention tag. We can add any fields you need as long as we keep PII out.
- VPC peering checklist: Ben will work with Peter and Marcos to get the firewall rules sorted.

Ben / Karthik — can you two confirm the target timeline below? If RetailAI confirms owners by Wednesday 21 Jul, Redwood will:
- Day 0-1: create sandbox, share endpoint + test credentials
- Day 2-4: ingest product prompts, run initial eval & iterate prompts with Samira
- Day 5-10: steady-state load tests + monitoring window
- Day 11-14: joint review and acceptance check (evaluate against success criteria)

Also tagging the procurement path in case of any SOW or temporary billing requirements. (HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9842)

Thanks,
Soojin

1) RetailAI can sign our standard trial form without a PO for sandbox access; however, if they want reserved capacity or extended retention we will need a short SOW and PO.
2) I've attached a lightweight RACI CSV that maps provisional owners to lanes (infra, app, security, procurement) — please treat it as a draft. If RetailAI prefers we rename lanes to match your org terms, that's fine.

Attachments: RACI-stakeholders.csv
Related: HubSpot integration ticket created (ID: HS-9842-TICKET-3)

Next actions I need from RetailAI:
- Confirm infra owner (name + email) for peering and keys
- Confirm acceptance of trial terms or flag the required redlines
- Confirm preferred cadence for daily check-ins during the load window (15m async vs 30m call)

I'll pick up the procurement intake once owners are confirmed.

Thanks all — following up with a concrete ops kickoff plan once owners are confirmed (per Samira's note, Peter is the primary infra owner). Two quick clarifications from engineering ops: 
- We need Marcos' contact (or whoever will configure the peering) to be added to the pilot-ops-contact-roster.csv so we can share keys and test SSH if required.
- For the trial telemetry, we'll expose a small Prometheus-compatible metrics endpoint and a downloadable audit log snapshot daily during the load window. Please confirm that is acceptable to security.

Proposed near-term schedule (tentative):
- Thu 22 Jul: short intro call (30m) with infra + app + security to walk the checklist
- Mon 26 Jul: Redwood provisions sandbox, endpoint shared to app owner
- Tue 27 Jul: ingestion & initial eval

If that works I will send calendar invites. Samira — can you confirm Marcos' email or delegate so we can get the peering checklist started?

Best,
